# Woven Woofs

> Daily numbered embroidered-patch-style dog portraits. One new patch every day, never reprinted.

## About

Woven Woofs is a daily collectible drop series: photorealistic embroidered-patch-style portraits of dogs in costumes, released one per day as numbered drops. Each drop is numbered in sequence (Nº 001, Nº 002, …) and never reprinted. Visitors can collect drops and track their collection; past drops live in the Vault archive.

## Drops

- [Latest drop and Vault archive](https://wovenwoofs.com/): today's numbered patch reveal with countdown to tomorrow's drop, plus the full archive of past drops, newest first.
- Drop Nº 001 — The Puggle Lion: a puggle in a lion mane.
- Drop Nº 002 — The Corgi Cadet: a corgi in an astronaut suit.

## How drops work

A new patch drops every day at midnight Eastern. Drops are numbered in release order and never reprinted. Collecting is free and tracked per device; no account needed.
